name: strategic-install-required-input-form
description: Collect required Strategic Install skill inputs in a Codex form.

interface.shortDescription: Collect skill inputs in a Codex form.
interface.longDescription: Shows non-sensitive required inputs in a Codex form before a Strategic Install skill starts. The service does not store submitted values.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the Strategic Install Required Input Form to collect missing skill inputs.
